project: Wuxia Life P94 Merchant 10-15 Growth Chain Reinforcement
description: Reinforce the merchant_house 10-15 growth chain with one post-fork visible confirmation, one first merchant challenge, player-facing expression updates, and narrow proof/regression coverage. Strictly bounded to merchant early-growth continuity; no full route rewrite, no skill system, no merchant_martial_patron bridge yet.

userStories.title: Audit the merchant 10-15 gap as a discrete implementation stage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the merchant 10-15 gap documented as its own bounded stage so implementation targets the missing chain instead of reopening the whole route.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the current merchant anchors across age 7-22
Explicitly identify the 10-15 gap between early fork and later shop or talent expression
Distinguish route is on from player feels continued growth
Save or update one bounded report under docs/test-reports/
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Read-only anchor and gap inventory for the implementation stage. Keeps the later stories from drifting into a full merchant rewrite.

userStories.title: Add one merchant post-fork confirmation in age 10-12
userStories.description: As a player, I want my early merchant fork choice to produce a visible confirmation within a short age window so I can tell that ledger and caravan are already shaping me differently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add exactly one merchant 10-12 confirmation event or equivalent narrow reinforcement node
The node requires merchant route entry plus one of hvg_merchant_ledger_track or hvg_merchant_caravan_track
Ledger and caravan present different player-facing text or outcome emphasis
The node changes at least one downstream state beyond flavor-only text
The node remains merchant-only and does not introduce a new progression container
No regression to merchant_childhood_seed_milestone or hvg_merchant_early_opportunity_fork eligibility
userStories.notes: First executable growth-confirmation node after the existing fork. This is the earliest missing link in the 10-15 chain.

userStories.title: Add one first merchant challenge in age 13-15
userStories.description: As a player, I want the merchant route to test the kind of merchant I am becoming so growth feels like responsibility and risk rather than passive accumulation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add exactly one merchant challenge node in age 13-15
The challenge is legible as a first real responsibility, mistake, or opportunity
Ledger and caravan differ in either condition, framing, or result
The challenge creates a small but readable consequence: stat shift, currentGoal change, eligibility shift, or route pressure
The challenge does not require a new subsystem
The challenge remains bounded to merchant_house
userStories.notes: This is the first real pressure point after the confirmation node. Keep it small and readable; do not jump to full shop ownership.

userStories.title: Preserve continuity into merchant talent and first shop
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the new 10-15 chain to connect naturally into existing merchant anchors so this stage strengthens continuity instead of creating another isolated branch.
acceptanceCriteria: The new 10-15 nodes do not orphan merchant_talent_discovery
The new 10-15 nodes keep merchant_first_shop as the next major age-16+ business milestone
At least one downstream condition, goal, or replay checkpoint reads differently after the new chain
Existing merchant age-40 identity logic is not weakened
P50 or replay merchant line remains deterministic under current benchmark expectations
userStories.notes: This is a continuity-wiring story, not a content-expansion story. The point is to make the new nodes feed existing anchors cleanly.

userStories.title: Strengthen player-facing expression for the 10-15 chain
userStories.description: As a player, I want the route to tell me what sort of merchant I am becoming so the loop feels authored rather than hidden in flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine at least two player-facing expressions tied to the new 10-15 chain
At least one expression is immediate to the event outcome
At least one expression survives into a later checkpoint, goal, or proof artifact
Expression language uses player-facing merchant terms rather than raw state-key names
No new dedicated UI panel is required
userStories.notes: Prefer reusing currentGoal, event outcome text, and existing player-facing labels over creating any new surface.

userStories.title: Add narrow proof and regression coverage for merchant 10-15
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want proof and focused tests for the merchant 10-15 chain so the stage closes on evidence instead of on intent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one focused test covering the new confirmation and challenge chain
Verify that ledger and caravan can both reach their intended branch-specific confirmation or challenge path
Produce or update one proof artifact under docs/test-reports/
Proof shows age, route flags, branch flag, and at least one changed player-facing outcome
Verification does not require reopening full-lifetime broad audits
npm run typecheck passes
Relevant merchant-focused tests pass
userStories.notes: Evidence-first closeout. Use narrow regression guards instead of broad all-route retesting unless the implementation actually touches shared engine behavior.

userStories.title: Produce stage closure and next-step boundary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that states exactly what this stage now proves and what remains deferred so the next stage stays bounded.
acceptanceCriteria: Save a closure report under docs/test-reports/
State what was added in age 10-15
State what remains deferred to later merchant route expansion
Explicitly say this stage does not yet enter merchant_martial_patron
Name the next bounded candidate stage after this one
userStories.notes: Close with explicit defer boundaries. Prevent the next session from turning this into a merchant full-route redesign.
